input: Write two sentences for a bank partner saying the weekly report will be late and a corrected file follows.
expected_output: The weekly report is late this week. A corrected file follows once the totals are confirmed, to be confirmed by our data team.
bad_output: The weekly report is late this week — a corrected file follows → once the totals are confirmed.
human_note: Read it as the partner would: is a comma, full stop or 'to' used where a dash would have gone, and does it still sound natural? The script only finds the characters.
why: Em-dashes and arrows are the most common AI-sounding slip in partner text. A wording change in the skill could drop B1 unnoticed.
